examples.arabic: ركبوا العربية بتاعتهم وراحوا السوق الكبير في القاهرة.
examples.english: They got into their car and went to the big market in Cairo.
examples.transliteration: Rakbou el 3arabeya beta3ethom we rahou el soo2 el kebir fi el Qahera.

examples.arabic: انا وبابا في العربية ومش عارفين الشارع
examples.english: My dad and I are in the car and we do not know the street.
examples.transliteration: ana wa baba fi el aarabeya wa mesh aarefeen el shareaa

examples.english: I go to work by car.
examples.transliteration: ana barouh el shoghl bel arabeya

examples.arabic: انا لسه سايقه العربيه عشان اجي المحل و كنت متعصبه اوي
examples.english: I just drove the car to come to the shop and I was very angry.
examples.transliteration: ana lessa sayqa el arabeya ashan agi el mahal wa kont metassaba awi

examples.arabic: وصلت العيلة كلها والجو كان حلو انا لسه سايقه العربيه عشان اجي البيت
examples.english: The whole family arrived, and the atmosphere was lovely; I just drove the car to come home.
examples.transliteration: Weselt el eila kolaha we el gaww kan helw ana lessa sayqa el arabeya ashan agi el bet

examples.arabic: انا لسه سايقه العربيه عشان اجي البيت عشان أساعدهم
examples.english: I just drove the car to come home to help them.
examples.transliteration: Ana lessa sayqa el arabeya ashan agi el bet ashan asa'edhom.
